answer: One concrete defense is a staked identity bond. Before an agent may trade, it must lock collateral in a bonded vault; provable misbehavior slashes that deposit, while honest agents later reclaim it, so the real cost is only opportunity. A sybil attacker cannot share one deposit across clones: every fake identity needs its own funded vault, so a thousand sybils demand a thousand bonds. Identity becomes scarce timber you must fell per account, and the economy grows like a tended garden where only staked participants take root.
